summary: Lifecycle-repair phase. Reproduced (live, before any change) and repaired a genuine finalization-ordering deadlock: Phase 137I completed with 5 unpushed commits and its task relocated to tasks/done/, but .pcae/phase-reports/latest.json still identified Phase 137H; pcae push readiness's phase-report-identity gate (137F.1/137F.1V) refused because latest.json did not identify the latest completed phase, while finalize_phase_report quarantined rather than wrote that report because the finalization gate hard-blocks on origin/main..HEAD > 0 -- a circular dependency (push needs a report finalization refuses to write until pushed) with no governed recovery. Root cause confirmed by code reading plus the live repro; the identity gate (137F.1V, working as designed) requires the report, but the lifecycle architecture omitted an intermediate state in which a completed-but-unpushed report can exist. Repaired additively with a non-authoritative pending_push canonical-report state written to latest.* only when the ONLY finalization blockers are push-state (blockers_are_push_state_only, a closed classifier) AND the report is otherwise fully complete (identity, coherence, governance, no-go, every non-push trust field) -- never trust-complete, never authoritative, never notified -- surfaced via the opt-in pcae phase complete --stage-pending-report flag; plus a case-insensitive fix to _check_phase_identity_consistency so 137I and the 137i idle-slug token no longer falsely disagree. No existing trust gate was weakened; genuine integrity blockers still quarantine, and allow_pending_push defaults to False so all existing callers/tests are unchanged. Recovered the live deadlocked repository end to end through the governed sequence (stage pending -> commit -> governed pcae push -> promote to COMPLETE with exactly one notification), with no raw git commit/push and no manual lifecycle override. Runtime unchanged throughout: Observed / observe / unavailable. Full report in docs/PHASE_137I1_FINALIZATION_ORDERING_DEADLOCK_REPAIR.md.
